repo_overview.summary: Minimal self-evolving autonomous agent (~3K core lines). A ~100-line agent loop gives any LLM control over the local computer through 9 atomic tools (code_run, file read/write/patch, web_scan/web_execute_js, ask_user, working checkpoint, long-term memory update). Solved tasks are written back as reusable SOPs/skills into a layered file memory (L1 insight index, L2 global facts, L3 SOPs, L4 session archive); many frontends (CLI/TUI/Qt/IM bots) wrap the same GenericAgent runtime.

topology.justification: The main GenericAgent delegates work to subagents by launching agentmain.py --func/--task as separate background processes (agentmain.py:209-220). Each subagent instantiates its own GeneraticAgent with its own LLM client and runs a full agent loop (agentmain.py:222-247), communicating with the parent through a file protocol (input.txt, output*.txt with [ROUND END], reply.txt, _stop/_keyinfo/_intervene; subagent.md:11-16, agentmain.py:249-253). The SOPs use this for parallel map processing, where each subtask gets its own isolated context to avoid cross-contamination (subagent.md:32-35), and for a supervisor role in which the parent only monitors and corrects the subagent (supervisor_sop.md:8-16). In Goal Hive mode a master agent and several worker agents run as separate agentmain processes, each with its own LLM loop, and coordinate over a BBS (goal_hive_sop.md:8, 30, 51). A boss agent delegating to helper agents with their own LLM loop makes the system multi-agent. The delegation is SOP-driven: the parent starts subagents via code_run when a prompt or SOP instructs it, and the default single-task path runs one agent.

resilience.name: unique-match guard for file patching
resilience.what_it_is: file_patch replaces old_content only if it occurs exactly once in the file; zero or multiple matches return an error with instructions (re-read with file_read, patch smaller blocks, ask the user after repeated failures, never fall back to overwrite).

resilience.name: empty / truncated LLM response retry

resilience.name: multi-model failover with spring-back

    """Multi-session fallback with spring-back to primary."""
    def __init__(self, all_sessions, cfg):
        self._retries, self._base_delay = cfg.get('max_retries', 3), cfg.get('base_delay', 1.5)
        self._spring_sec = cfg.get('spring_back', 300)

    try:
        with open(path, encoding='utf-8', errors='replace') as fh:
            content = fh.read()
    except Exception:
        return None
    if not _pairs(content):

def restore(agent, path):
    """Restore session at path. Returns (msg, is_full)."""
    try:
        with open(path, encoding='utf-8', errors='replace') as fh:
            content = fh.read()
    except Exception as e: return f'❌ 读取失败: {e}', False
    pairs = _pairs(content)
    if not pairs: return f'❌ {os.path.basename(path)} 为空或格式不符', False
    history = _parse_native_history(pairs)
    name = os.path.basename(path)
    if history is not None:
        agent.abort()
        _replace_backend_history(agent, history)
        return f'✅ 已恢复 {len(pairs)} 轮完整对话（{name}）\n(已写入 backend.history，可直接继续)', True
    from chatapp_common import _restore_native_history, _restore_text_pairs
    summary = _restore_text_pairs(content) or _restore_native_history(content)
    if not summary: return f'❌ {name} 无法解析（非 native 且无摘要可提取）', False
    agent.abort()
    agent.history.extend(summary)
    n = sum(1 for l in summary if l.startswith('[USER]: '))
    return f'⚠️ 非 native 格式，已降级恢复 {n} 轮摘要（{name}）\n(请输入新问题继续)', False

resilience.name: GUI locator fallback chain
resilience.what_it_is: The computer-use SOP fixes an ordered locator chain: win32gui window enumeration first, then the UIA control tree, then ui_detect on a ljqCtrl screenshot, and a VLM last for semantic confirmation only, with its coordinates treated as untrusted. Moves to the next locating method when one fails and keeps the most reliable available method in use. Otherwise the agent keeps clicking on unreliable coordinates such as VLM guesses or retries a control tree that does not work for the window.
